data.name: Buraik
data.gender_notes: Buraik is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Buraik means 'the illuminator'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'buraq', which means 'light' or 'illumination'. In Islamic tradition, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is said to have travelled on Buraq during his Night Journey from Mecca to Jerusalem and then to heaven. This name is thus deeply spiritual and symbolizes enlightenment and guidance.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents guidance and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Buraik belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The illuminator.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Buraik total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Sa'd, Al-Tabaqat Al-Kubra, Volume 3, Page 167 The name Buraik carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Buraik ibn Haseebah Al-Aslami was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. He participated in the Battle of Uhud and was one of the thirty-six who were given the title of 'the good news' by the Prophet.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hajar Al-Haytami, Al-Isabah fi Tamyiz Al-Sahabah, Volume 1, Page 300 The name Buraik carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Buraik ibn Haseebah Al-Aslami was a participant in the Battle of Hunain, where the Muslims defeated the army of the tribes of Hawazin and Thaqif. He was one of the commanders of the Muslim army and was given the title of 'the right-handed' due to his ability to wield a sword effectively with his right hand.
